_comment: Animated page-turn 'more' icon for the boxed-portrait DialogueBox — shown at the box bottom-right while a NEXT PAGE is pending during scenario pagination. 4-frame page-corner-curl loop (bottom-left corner folds up 0->3, then resets). Frames live in the shared RANGETILE atlas (RANGETILE.tga; == ShiShi's FRAME sheet; LBA 0xE68 raw-sector disc asset, 256x256 4bpp, tpage 0x3F) — NOT in EVENT/FRAME.BIN. UVs are runtime-assembled in-game (no literal SPRT rodata); phase = dialogue_frame_counter & 0x3 (battle 0x8012f81c). These cells are ISO-verified by tools/parse_range_tiles.py (page_turn_icon, fixture-guarded) and also emitted into RANGETILE.json; committed here (assets/ui/*.json is git-tracked) so the coordinate data survives without the ISO/regeneration. See research/working_documents/scenario_1_captures/dialogue_pagination_and_page_icon_decode.md §3.4.
